sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Come, Christians, follow where our Captain trod,
Our King victorious, Christ, the Son of God.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim,
Till all the world adore His sacred Name.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Led on their way by this triumphant sign,
The hosts of God in conquering ranks combine.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: All newborn soldiers of the Crucified
Bear on their brows the seal of Him Who died.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: O Lord, once lifted on the glorious tree,
As Thou hast promised, draw us all to Thee.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: So shall our song of triumph ever be:
Praise to the Crucified for victory!
